items.brief: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans; crypto firms remain
items.why: Tokenized stock offerings face rejection from major issuers, shaping who can issue tokenized equities.

items.brief: Crypto firms expand into stablecoins and payments, but earnings show boom-and-bust strain
items.why: Stablecoin and payments growth tied to crypto cycles affects tokenized asset business models.
